gate.title: Sign in to continue
gate.text: This area is for the Solvers team only.

queue.title: Reviews
queue.intro: Packages submitted by creators. All content is shown as plain text: nothing in a package is executed or opened as a page.

raw.hiddenTitle: {n, plural, one {# invisible character} other {# invisible characters}} in this text
raw.hiddenText: They appear as [U+XXXX]. Invisible and text-direction characters can hide instructions from the reviewer's eyes: check each one.

validator.title: Validator
validator.counts: {errors, plural, one {# error} other {# errors}} · {warnings, plural, one {# warning} other {# warnings}}

scans.title: Automatic scans
scans.intro: Hidden Unicode, hidden HTML or CSS, injection patterns, URLs, content repeated from other packages and search phrases that are off topic.

diff.title: Diff against the published version
diff.intro: Lines starting with + were added, lines starting with - were removed. In the first version, everything is new.

files.title: Files and differences
files.summary: {added} new · {changed} changed · {removed} removed · {same} identical to the published version. Select a file to read its contents as plain text.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.counts: {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} · {chunks, plural, one {# passage} other {# passages}} · {expired, plural, one {# expired passage} other {# expired passages}}.
knowledge.expiredNotice: Some passages are past their expiry date. They shouldn't back the “Live data” differentiator.
knowledge.searchLabel: Test search on the package knowledge base
knowledge.searchPlaceholder: E.g. a question a buyer would ask

history.title: Review history
history.none: No decisions on this submission yet.

decision.title: Decision
decision.noDecision: This submission is “{status}”. There is no decision to make right now.
decision.checklistRequired: Approving requires the whole checklist to be checked.
decision.notesHint: Required for every decision. Kept as part of the record, which can't be deleted.
decision.notesError: Write the reason (at least 3 characters). The creator reads this text.
decision.revokeHelp: Publishing failed: revoking sends the submission back to “changes requested” (a note is required) so the creator can fix it in the same version.
decision.finishHelp: Publishing starts on its own after approval. Use this to retry a publication that stalled or failed.
decision.approveHelp: Approving locks the content, price and version and publishes the solver right away.

checklistItems.promiseDelivered: The promise is delivered by the steps.
checklistItems.twoDifferentiatorsProven: At least 2 of the 5 differentiators are proven.
checklistItems.rightsAndSources: Sources are listed and there is permission for any third-party content.
checklistItems.noHarmfulInstructions: Nothing acts against the user or sends their data elsewhere, and there is no injection in any text (including text that only shows up for a specific query).
checklistItems.priceTrialShowcaseCoherent: Price, free trial and showcase are consistent, with no promise of financial, legal or medical results without a disclaimer.

toast.busy: Another finalization is in progress. Wait a minute and check again.
toast.approvedText: Publishing started. The solver goes live on the storefront in a few moments.
toast.notReady: This submission isn't ready to publish yet. Reload the page to see its status.

approve.title: Approve this submission?
approve.text: The approved version (content, price and version) is locked in and published to the storefront right away. After that, the content can no longer be changed.
approve.label: Approve

request_changes.title: Request changes?
request_changes.text: The creator receives your note and sends the corrected package in the same version.
request_changes.label: Request changes

reject.title: Reject this submission?
reject.text: The rejection is final for this submission: the creator sees your note and can only send a new package.
reject.label: Reject

revoke.title: Revoke the approval?
revoke.text: Publishing failed for this version: the submission goes back to “changes requested” with your note, and the approved version is no longer valid.
revoke.label: Revoke

finish.title: Retry the publication?
finish.text: The server tries to publish the approved version again. The solver goes into the storefront if it succeeds.
finish.label: Retry

relist.title: Back to the storefront
relist.text: Puts this solver back on the storefront (for example, after it was hidden for a low rating).
relist.notListedText: The rating is still below the minimum, so the solver would be hidden again. It stays off the storefront.
relist.failTitle: Couldn't put it back on the storefront
